airRouteControl.name: Concrete body -> complete bottom bed -> bonded DPC body/perpends/upper bed -> wall core below plaster stop -> plaster
rules: First compare the actual bonded mineral assembly as a complete air transition; neither brick absorption nor mortar designation demonstrates its leakage
Include the 30 mm wall-core height above DPC and below plaster stop; do not jump from DPC top -30 to plaster at0
Do not plaster continuously down to wet RC and around the DPC; do not close an air drawing by creating a damp bypass
Concrete moisture resistance, air permeability, crack/joint leakage and gas suitability remain separate duties
Do not assume a new metal return is needed or qualified; if used it needs actual cast-in depth, cage/compaction, weld, movement and plaster-interface evidence
